content: Advanced wound therapies, as classified by the American Diabetes Association (ADA), are divided into nine primary categories, as detailed in Table 12.2. Clinical trials and research studies have demonstrated differing degrees of efficacy among these therapeutic approaches. Similarly, hyperbaric oxygen therapy has shown potential benefits, particularly in the treatment of chronic diabetic foot ulcers (DFUs). However, further rigorous research is required to substantiate these findings and optimize their application in clinical practice.
